about: Outside research: open-data portals + GIS servers per US state / Canadian province (updated Nov 1 12:14 AM).

rows.Notes: Alabama GeoHub. Search answers with a list but had 0 hits for 'park'. G = Alabama GeoHub ArcGIS Online. H and I are the same server: State Parks and Wildlife & Freshwater Fisheries are both in ADCNR. J = Alabama Forestry Commission.

Alaska Statewide Geoportal (run by DNR). Its Hub search API does not answer, so F uses an ArcGIS Online search of the DNR org (7HDiw78fcUiM2BWn). State Parks and the Division of Forestry & Fire are both in DNR, so H and J are the DNR server. I = ADF&G.
AZGeo Data Hub (AGIC). The older azgeo-open-data-agic hub returns 401. I = AZ Game & Fish ArcGIS Online. I could not confirm a GIS server for Arizona State Parks or DFFM, so H and J are blank.
Arkansas GIS Office hub. I = AGFC. I found no separate server for State Parks or Forestry, so H and J are blank. Their layers may be on the GIS Office server in G.

G = CDT (state GIS) ArcGIS Online. H = CA State Parks. I = CDFW. J = CAL FIRE. CDFW's own server (map.dfg.ca.gov) and CAL FIRE's (egis.fire.ca.gov) return HTML or bot pages to automated checks, so I left them out.

Column C link is broken: https://cpw.state.co.us/learn/Pages/GIS.aspx returns 404 (CPW moved to a new site). H and I are the same CPW ArcGIS Online org, since parks and wildlife are one agency. I could not confirm a server for the CO State Forest Service.
H, I and J are the same CT DEEP ArcGIS Online org: State Parks, Wildlife and Forestry are all DEEP divisions.

G = FirstMap (state GIS). H and I = DNREC GIS org (Parks & Recreation and Fish & Wildlife are DNREC divisions). The Delaware Forest Service is in the Dept of Agriculture and I found no separate server, so J is blank.
DPR (parks), DOEE (wildlife) and the Urban Forestry Division publish through the central DC GIS server in G. I found no separate agency servers.

rows.What we know already: Florida DEP GIS open data (geodata.dep.state.fl.us): https://geodata.dep.state.fl.us/; Florida DEP Map Direct: https://ca.dep.state.fl.us/mapdirect/
rows.Notes: Main = Florida GIO hub. The DEP hub in column C also works. G = Florida GIO ArcGIS Online. H = FDEP: State Parks is DEP's Division of Recreation & Parks. I = FWC, including the FWRI server. J = FDACS, the parent of the Florida Forest Service. FWC also has a hub: geodata.myfwc.com.

Georgia GIO hub. Search answers with a list but had 0 hits for 'park'. G = GaGIO ArcGIS Online. I = GADNR Wildlife Resources Division. J = Georgia Forestry Commission. I found no server for GA State Parks (a GADNR division).
Hawaii Statewide GIS Program. DLNR (State Parks, DOFAW wildlife and forestry) layers are on the statewide server in G. I found no separate DLNR server, so H, I and J are blank.
The Idaho Map (state hub). IDPR has a hub (idpr-data-idaho.hub.arcgis.com) inside the State of Idaho org, so H is the same as G. I = IDFG. J = Idaho Dept of Lands, which runs state forestry.
G = Illinois State Geological Survey (the state clearinghouse, run at UIUC). H, I and J = IDNR ArcGIS Online: parks, wildlife and forestry are all IDNR. The IDNR hub (data-idnr) returns 401.
IndianaMap. I could not confirm a separate IDNR server, so H, I and J are blank. IDNR layers are on IndianaMap and gisdata.in.gov.

Column C correction: geodata.iowa.gov is the State of Iowa geodata hub (ArcGIS org 'State of Iowa'), not Iowa DNR. Iowa DNR's server is programs.iowadnr.gov/geospatial. H, I and J are the same DNR servers. data.iowa.gov no longer answers the Socrata API.
Kansas GIS hub (DASC). G = DASC/KARS server at the University of Kansas, the state's GIS data host. I found no confirmed server for KDWP or the Kansas Forest Service.

KyGovMaps Open Data. The column C link (kygeonet.ky.gov) opens. I = KDFWR. J = Energy & Environment Cabinet ArcGIS Online (parent of the Division of Forestry). I found no separate server for KY State Parks.

Louisiana has no statewide open-data portal. The best official one is the LaDOTD hub, and its Hub API returns 404, so F searches the LADOTD ArcGIS Online org. The state GIS page is https://doa.la.gov/doa/osl/gis-data/. I found no confirmed servers for State Parks (CRT), LDWF or LDAF Forestry.

Maine GeoLibrary hub. The column C link opens, but the other GeoLibrary hub (geolibrary-maine) returns 401. Parks (DACF), IF&W and Forest Service layers are on the State of Maine server and org in G. I found no separate agency servers.

Column C (imap.maryland.gov) opens. geodata.md.gov/imap/rest showed a maintenance page, so I used mdgeodata.md.gov. DNR (parks, wildlife, forest service) layers are in the iMAP folders. I found no separate DNR server.
MassGIS. H, I and J are the same EEA ArcGIS Online org: DCR (parks and forests) and MassWildlife are within EEA.
State of Michigan hub. H, I and J are the same MDNR ArcGIS Online org (parks, wildlife and forestry are all DNR). DNR hub: gis-midnr.opendata.arcgis.com.

Column C URL gisdata.mn.gov now redirects to gis.data.mn.gov, which is an ArcGIS Hub; the old CKAN API is gone. MN DNR datasets are in the us_mn_state_dnr folders on the server in G. MN DNR's own server (arcgis.dnr.state.mn.us) did not answer with JSON, so H, I and J are blank.
Mississippi open GIS hub. J = Mississippi Forestry Commission. I could not confirm servers for the state GIS (MARIS) or MDWFP; maris.state.ms.us did not connect.

G = MSDIS (state GIS clearinghouse at the University of Missouri). H = MoDNR, which runs Missouri State Parks. I and J = MDC, which covers both wildlife and forestry. MDC hub: gis-mdc.opendata.arcgis.com.

Montana State Library Geographic Information has no catalog API, so F searches its ArcGIS Online org (Montana Geographic Information). Column C link is broken: https://fwp.mt.gov/conservation/gis returns 404. The FWP hub is gis-mtfwp.hub.arcgis.com. H and I are the same FWP server, since State Parks is in FWP. I could not confirm a DNRC Forestry server.
NebraskaMAP. H and I are the same Nebraska Game & Parks org. The Nebraska Forest Service (UNL) has no confirmed server.

Nevada has no statewide open-data or GIS portal. The best official one is the NDCNR Data Hub, and its Hub API returns 404, so F searches the NDCNR ArcGIS Online org. NBMG's Virtual Clearinghouse is only a directory, so G is blank. H = NV State Parks, I = NDOW, J = Nevada Division of Forestry.
NH GRANIT (the state clearinghouse, run at UNH). I found no separate servers for NH State Parks (DNCR), NH Fish & Game or the Division of Forests & Lands.
NJGIN open data. H, I and J are the same NJDEP servers: Parks & Forestry and Fish & Wildlife are DEP divisions.

RGIS is New Mexico's state clearinghouse (run by EDAC at UNM) and uses the GSToRE API, which is not one of the five standard patterns. The NM Geospatial hub (geospatial-gcc-nm.hub.arcgis.com) works but had 0 hits for 'park'. I = NM Game & Fish. I could not confirm servers for State Parks (EMNRD) or the Forestry Division.

Column C correction: gis.ny.gov is the NYS GIS Program Office (ITS), not DEC. DEC's server is gisservices.dec.ny.gov, which also has a 'NYS Parks' reference layer. I and J are the same DEC servers (Fish & Wildlife and Lands & Forests). I found no public OPRHP (State Parks) server, so H is blank.
NC OneMap. I = NCWRC. J = NCDA&CS ArcGIS Online, the parent of the NC Forest Service. I found no separate server for NC State Parks (DNCR).
ND GIS Hub. ND Parks & Recreation and Game & Fish layers are on the state GIS Hub server and org in G. J = ND Forest Service.

GEOhio (OGRIP). Its Hub API returns 401, so F searches the OGRIP ArcGIS Online org (only 1 hit for 'park'). data.ohio.gov has no public search API. H, I and J are the same ODNR servers (parks, wildlife and forestry are ODNR divisions). I could not confirm who owns maps.ohio.gov.
I = ODWC. I found no confirmed server for OKMaps (state GIS), OK State Parks (Tourism) or Oklahoma Forestry Services; okmaps.org/arcgis did not return JSON.
Oregon GEOHub. H = OPRD. ODFW and ODF publish in the shared 'Oregon ArcGIS Online' org in G. I found no separate public servers for them.

PASDA is the state clearinghouse (Penn State). Column C (dcnr.pa.gov/Maps/) now redirects to the general DCNR page, www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr. H and J are the same DCNR server (Parks and Bureau of Forestry folders). I = PA Game Commission. The DCNR hub is newdata-dcnr.opendata.arcgis.com.
RIGIS (URI EDC). H, I and J are the same RIDEM servers (parks, fish & wildlife and forest environment are DEM divisions).

Main = SC RFA Geospatial Resources Hub, the statewide portal. Its Hub API returns 404, so the first search in F uses the RFA ArcGIS Online org. Both searches answer with a list but had 0 hits for 'park'. The column C link (SCDNR public lands hub) opens. I = SCDNR, J = SC Forestry Commission. I found no confirmed server for SC State Parks (PRT).
SD BIT open data hub. H and I are the same SD Game, Fish & Parks org. I found no confirmed server for Forestry (Dept of Agriculture & Natural Resources); arcgis.sd.gov did not connect.
TNMap. H = TDEC (TN State Parks). I = TWRA. J = TN Division of Forestry.
G = TxGIO. H and I are the same TPWD servers. J = Texas A&M Forest Service. The column C link (tpwd.texas.gov/gis/) opens.
G = UGRC. H, I and J are the same Utah DNR org (State Parks, DWR and FFSL are DNR divisions).
VCGI open geodata. H, I and J are the same ANR servers (Forests, Parks & Recreation and Fish & Wildlife are ANR departments).
G = VGIN. H = DCR (VA State Parks). I = DWR. J = VDOF.
Washington Geoportal (geo.wa.gov). I could not confirm a separate state GIS office server, so G is blank. H = WA State Parks, I = WDFW, J = WA DNR.

The WV GIS Technical Center clearinghouse (WVU, the state's GIS data host) opens but has no standard search API, so F is blank. I could not confirm servers for WVDNR or the WV Division of Forestry; gis.wvdnr.gov did not connect.

Wisconsin has no single state open-data portal, so the main portal is the WDNR hub from column C. I found no state GIS office server, so G is blank. H, I and J are the same WDNR servers (parks, wildlife and forestry are DNR).

Wyoming GeoHub (WyGISC, University of Wyoming). H = WY State Parks, Historic Sites & Trails. I = WGFD: the org has no public name, but WGFD's open-data site links to its services. The WGFD hub is wyoming-wgfd.opendata.arcgis.com. I found no confirmed server for Wyoming State Forestry.
Open Alberta. G = Government of Alberta geospatial server (titan). I could not confirm separate servers for Alberta Parks, Fish & Wildlife or Forestry.
BC Data Catalogue plus the openmaps WFS. BC Parks, wildlife and forestry layers come from the BC Geographic Warehouse through the services in G and F. I found no separate agency servers.
Manitoba GeoPortal. G = Manitoba Maps ArcGIS Online. I could not confirm separate servers for parks, wildlife or forestry.

The GeoNB data catalogue has no search API. F searches New Brunswick's records on open.canada.ca (organization 'nb'), which had only 1 hit. I could not confirm a server for NB Natural Resources and Energy Development (parks, wildlife, forestry).
opendata.gov.nl.ca is a custom portal without CKAN or Socrata APIs, so F uses the NL GeoHub. G = Government of NL ArcGIS Online. I could not confirm separate servers for parks, wildlife or forestry.

G = NS geographic information server (nsgiwa). H = NS Environment & Climate Change org (protected areas). NS Natural Resources (provincial parks, wildlife, forestry) layers are on nsgiwa. I found no separate server for them.

NWT open data (CKAN). Search answers with a list but had 0 hits for 'park'. G = NWT Centre for Geomatics and the GNWT ArcGIS Online orgs. I found no separate servers for ITI (parks) or ECC (wildlife and forestry).

Nunavut has no territorial open-data portal or public GIS server that I could find. The Government of Nunavut publishes geospatial data through open.canada.ca, so F is a federal portal search for 'Nunavut park'. D, G, H, I and J are blank.
G = Land Information Ontario. I and J are the same MNR ArcGIS Online org. Ontario Parks layers are in LIO, and I found no separate server for them.
PEI Open Data is an ArcGIS Hub (org zow9Ot3ujGSyJI3C), not Socrata. Parks, forests, fish & wildlife layers are on the PEI GIS server in G.

Données Québec (CKAN). F searches 'parc' (French), which returns 133 results; 'park' returns only 1. G = MRNF provincial mapping services. I could not confirm separate servers for SEPAQ, MELCCFP (wildlife) or forestry.
Saskatchewan GeoHub. Parks, environment (wildlife and forestry) layers are on the provincial server and org in G. I found no separate servers.
Open Yukon (CKAN). Yukon Parks, Fish & Wildlife and Forest Management (Dept of Environment / EMR) layers are on the Government of Yukon server and org in G.

Federal row. G = Federal Geospatial Platform server (folders by department, including NRCan and PC) and the NRCan public proxy server, which has the CLSS national park legislative boundaries. H = Parks Canada ArcGIS Online. Parks Canada also has an open-data hub (data-apca). NRCan GeoGratis has no standard search API, and its data is listed in open.canada.ca. I and J are blank: wildlife (ECCC/CWS) and forestry (NRCan CFS) have no separate confirmed servers.

Federal row. The old CKAN API (catalog.data.gov/api/3) now returns 404. Data.gov's new Catalog API is api.gsa.gov/technology/datagov/v4/search; the DEMO_KEY in F is rate-limited, so get a free api.data.gov key for heavy use. Federal columns: G = BLM (the federal land agency with no other column), H = NPS (mapservices plus the NPS ArcGIS Online org), I = USFWS ArcGIS Online, J = USFS (EDW arcx server plus the USFS ArcGIS Online org).
